description: Test suite for model access control and management in the Litellm project, including key and team creation, updating access policies, and verifying access restrictions through mocked chat completions.

methods.name: generate_key( session, models: Optional[List[str]] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Helper function to generate an API key with specific model access controls.

methods.name: generate_team(session, models: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Helper function to create a team with specific model access restrictions.

methods.name: mock_chat_completion(session, key: str, model: str)
methods.description: Simulates a chat completion request using the OpenAI SDK with mock responses.

methods.name: test_model_access_patterns(key_models, test_model, expect_success)
methods.description: Parameterized test to verify access restrictions based on model patterns for API keys.

methods.name: test_model_access_update()
methods.description: Test to verify updating model access restrictions for an existing key.

methods.name: test_team_model_access_patterns(team_models, test_model, expect_success)
methods.description: Parameterized test to verify model access restrictions for team keys.

methods.name: test_team_model_access_update()
methods.description: Test to verify updating model access restrictions for a team.

methods.name: _validate_model_access_exception( e: Exception, expected_type: Literal["key_model_access_denied", "team_model_access_denied"], )
methods.description: Helper to validate the structure and content of model access denial exceptions.

ctags.name: generate_key
ctags.signature: ( session, models: Optional[List[str]] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None )

ctags.name: mock_chat_completion
ctags.pattern: /^async def mock_chat_completion(session, key: str, model: str):$/
